_meta.title: Value Compass — evidence classification
_meta.what_this_is: A derived layer. It adds no facts. For every recorded axis assessment it records what the written rationale rests on, which of its sources are about that maker, and whether the score may be shown or compared.
_meta.display_rule: A score whose rationale establishes only that information is undisclosed is withheld from the compass, the matrix and all comparisons. The recorded value is preserved and shown on request.
_meta.comparison_rule: A difference between two makers is only called when both assessments rest on evidence about that maker and carry confidence A or B.

bases.sourced: Rationale points at something on record and cites a source about this maker.
bases.unsourced: Rationale points at something on record, but no source about this maker is attached.
bases.contextual: Rationale reasons from jurisdiction, company size or position in the stack, not from evidence about this maker.
bases.non_disclosure: Rationale establishes only that the information is not published.

relationship_types.controlling_stake: A stake the record describes as controlling.
relationship_types.equity_investment: Money invested for a stake. Not by itself control.
relationship_types.funding_commitment: Money announced or committed. Check the status field for whether it has been paid.
relationship_types.commercial_dependency: An investor who is also a supplier or customer of the maker.
relationship_types.passive_economic: Index-fund ownership of a public parent. Economic exposure, exercised through routine governance votes.
relationship_types.unspecified: This dataset records a backing relationship but not what kind.

relationship_statuses.completed: The record describes this as done.
relationship_statuses.announced: Announced. The record does not say it has closed.
relationship_statuses.pending: The record describes it as not yet closed.
relationship_statuses.contingent: Part or all of it depends on a future event.
